import.title: Import technicians
import.description: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file to create many technicians at once.

partShipments.title: Part Shipments
partShipments.subtitle: Parts technicians send back after a repair: receive them, price them, pay the technician.
partShipments.searchPlaceholder: Search by tracking code, technician or guarantee code...
partShipments.deleteDesc: This will permanently delete shipment #{{id}}. The parts in it become available to send again.

receive.title: Receive shipment
receive.description: Shipment #{{id}} from {{name}}. Tick every part that is actually in the parcel.

invoice.title: Invoice shipment
invoice.description: Shipment #{{id}} from {{name}}. Give a price for each part that arrived.

pay.title: Pay technician
pay.description: Shipment #{{id}}. Record the payment made to {{name}}.

reject.title: Reject shipment
reject.description: Shipment #{{id}} from {{name}}: nothing usable arrived. The parts become available to send again.
reject.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this shipment being rejected?

partShipments.mySubtitle: Send the parts you replaced back to the company, and follow your payment.
partShipments.awaitingTitle: {{count}} replaced part(s) still have to be sent back
partShipments.awaitingDesc: After you file a repair report, the old components must be sent to the company. Payment is calculated once they arrive.
partShipments.cancelConfirm: Cancel shipment #{{id}}? The parts will be listed as waiting to be sent again.
partShipments.remindAfterRepair: Remember to send the replaced parts back.

form.title: Send replaced parts
form.description: Choose the old components you are sending in this parcel and tell us how they are travelling.
form.nothingDesc: Every part from your repair reports has already been sent.
form.conditionPlaceholder: Condition of the part (e.g. burnt, cracked) - optional
form.notesPlaceholder: Anything the office should know about this parcel
form.success: Shipment submitted. You will be paid once the company receives and invoices it.

smsTemplates.title: SMS Patterns
smsTemplates.subtitle: The approved Melli Payamak patterns this system sends against. Register a pattern in the panel, then put its body id here.
smsTemplates.deleteDesc: This will permanently delete the pattern "{{name}}". Anything set to send with it will stop sending.
smsTemplates.unconfiguredTitle: {{count}} built-in pattern(s) have no body id yet
smsTemplates.unconfiguredDesc: Those messages will not be sent until you enter the body id registered in your Melli Payamak panel.

form.description: The body id comes from the pattern you registered in the Melli Payamak panel.
form.keyHint: Used to refer to this pattern. Letters, numbers and underscores.
form.keyLocked: The key cannot be changed once the pattern exists.
form.name: Name
form.bodyIdHint: The numeric bodyId shown next to the pattern in the Melli Payamak panel. Leave empty until you have it.
form.sampleTextPlaceholder: Paste the text you registered, so you can see what will be delivered
form.sampleTextHint: For reference only. The provider holds the real copy; the system only supplies the values.

test.title: Send a test message
test.description: Sends one real SMS using "{{name}}" (body id {{bodyId}}).
test.textHint: This fills the placeholder in the approved pattern.
